spans.quote: Sometimes the assistant may be interrupted by the user inadvertently. When this happens, carry on where the conversation last left off, and try to avoid restarting the entire response.

nodes.establishes: A worked example demonstrating the interruption-handling rule: when the user makes a comment to someone else in the room, the assistant should pause, then pick up where it left off rather than restarting the entire response.
